development_information: The previous 60 test seeds are development evidence only. None are reused in this confirmatory test.
seed_convention: half-open ranges; PRNG streams use these fixed seeds
driver: Fixed balanced logistic regression on passive features, trained on disjoint driver seeds; risk requests if anomaly probability > .35 or optional evidence absent; detector thresholds never affect acquisition
classifier: Two fixed four-class HistGradientBoostingClassifier models, passive versus passive+optional; max_iter=80, max_leaf_nodes=15, learning_rate=.08, l2_regularization=1, class_weight=balanced, early_stopping=False, random_state=19. Train on every fourth scored tick across all registered acquisition cells; no hyperparameter search
score: 1-P(healthy); all calibration and test scores rounded to float32 before thresholding; strict score > threshold
features: Causal completed-user mean, median, upper quartile, standard deviation, past arrival/completion rates, age of last user completion, own past query rate, configured probe work and shared/isolated flag; full model additionally receives optional RTT, presence, request age and difference from user mean. No tick, episode label, intervention command, true queue state or nominal load label
healthy_calibration: 199 independent entirely healthy trajectories per fixed load/work/mode/policy cell. Thresholds are per-cell and per-model; not chosen by test outcomes
block_threshold: ceil((n+1)*(1-.05))-th order statistic of per-deployment maxima over all 280 scored ticks; infinity if order exceeds n. Valid marginal per-healthy-deployment error <=.05 requires exchangeability of complete healthy deployments within the fixed cell and frozen acquisition policy. No theorem for arbitrary drift, calibration-conditional risk, malicious traffic, new cells or infinite horizons
naive_comparator: Pooled-window .99 quantile across the same healthy calibration trajectories. This ignores within-deployment dependence; no conformal event-level guarantee claimed
metrics: Any alarm within first 30 ticks of each nonhealthy episode; correct mechanism within30 separately; per-deployment any false alarm on fully healthy traces; normal-window FPR including recovery separately; four-class macro-F1; censored detection delay; average per-scenario user-p95; total actual probe work, request freshness, completion freshness, late receipts and unresolved probes
secondary: Full versus strong passive on same schedules; guarded_periodic separates load admission from learned scheduling; isolated and low-load controls; always-normal sanity baseline; additional healthy workload burst from .70 to .97 during[120,240) uses unchanged .70 calibration and is explicitly out-of-distribution
statistics: 120 independent test seeds. Paired 10000-resample seed-cluster bootstrap for primary mean contrasts; one-sided exact Clopper-Pearson upper for healthy event false alarms. Only declared primary conjunction confirmatory; other slices descriptive. No post-test model selection
scope: New synthetic closed-loop queue study, not native 5G/KIE protocol or cryptographic validation. Exogenous user arrivals and work paired across schedules. Optional probe work consumes common capacity only in shared mode. User latency includes eventual FCFS completion to avoid excluding unfinished slow requests. KIE mandatory cost, signatures, packet bytes and independent trust roots are not modeled. This is a calibration/observability test, not a claim of scientific priority.
